coordinate_space: skin Basis local space; skin local +Y is the facial anterior axis
method: Fresh WIP8 pass. Mouth-height region is held by a Z 1.496-1.503 taper; lower face moves down a maximum 4mm and jaw sides open before the chin. No eye, lid, lash, UV, pigment, global-scale or image-fit change.

landmark_hypothesis.eye_to_mouth: retain WIP8 approximately; source and WIP8 were already near under manual IPD-normalized observation
landmark_hypothesis.mouth_to_chin: increase modestly; initial visual test uses about 4mm lower-carrier displacement, not a fixed source measurement

limits: P2 does not solve the midface wedge or eyelid curvature; those require subsequent isolated passes.
Actual source/baseline/candidate fixed-camera review and limited deformation probes remain required before selection.
